entries.body:
**2026-10-26, b4c8112d8**
- rideamsterdam.nl home page: a **Free ride** button in the hero and the Ride card. It opens `/ride?ride=free`, which starts roaming straight away.
- iPhone graphics loss (Sentry CANAL-RECALL-7):
  - Temporary fix: the Reload notice now appears 2.5 s after a loss. It also stays up when Safari restores the context without our 3D layers.
  - Instrumentation: a new `webgl-context-restored` event, plus uptime, tab visibility, time since the tab was last hidden, and three.js memory/program counts on every graphics report. The next iPhone event should show whether the cause is backgrounding or memory.

**2026-10-25 — Helmersbuurt and Haarlemmerweg are live.** 33 houses on Eerste and Derde Helmersstraat are built from street photos with a new kit: stone jamb blocks, relieving arches, wall dormers with battlements, deep white cornices with brackets, and the painted-black front at no. 122. Review sent the first try back twice, for a green house and a plum one. On the Haarlemmerweg, the Carpetright hall at no. 337 is in. The Da Vinci building and the Waterkeringweg block are held until the kit can draw their side-light windows and loggias; a lane is adding that now (#86). Repeated designs round 9 (#85) is running.

**2026-10-25 — round 8 of repeated designs is live.** 447 more houses now use designs measured from street photos: Oostoever Sloterplas (246, garage-under-living-room rows), De Klomp in Weesp (104), Weesp-Zuid I (68, round-headed porches, diamond surrounds, portholes) and Sporenburg garage rows (29). Gallery: designs.html now lists 104 designs. The review sent one design back: its sheet showed it 1.27× too big, which turned out to be a stale cached photo, and the re-shoot also fixed the garage doors and brick colour.

Still in review: the Helmersbuurt block-face kit (#81, 13 houses ready, sent back because one house came out green and the painted-black facade came out plum) and the big Haarlemmerweg 333 buildings (#83, Carpetright installing, Da Vinci building and Waterkeringweg block sent back).

**Dev log, 25 Oct (round 7)**

- **995 more houses:**
  - **Bos en Lommer / Baarsjes, 1920s:** the banded brick portiek blocks of Orteliusbuurt and Jan Maijenbuurt around the Mercatorplein, about 60 % of each. Every one of these houses was checked against its own photo.
  - **Osdorp, Middelveldsche Akerpolder (1980s):** 519 houses in 5 designs, with porthole windows and red, yellow and green doors.
- **Skipped:** John Franklinbuurt is too varied (stoops, balconies, galleries); only 23 plain rows were placed there.
- **Running total:** about **8,450 houses on ~64 designs in 27 neighbourhoods**.
- **Next:** a **Helmersbuurt kit** (#81) is under way. It's a different approach for the varied 1890s streets: a library of row types placed block by block, measured for windows and white stone details.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (round 6)**

- **944 more houses:**
  - Postjeskade area: 4-storey blocks with bay windows and dormers (57 %)
  - Kantershof: white patio houses with green, yellow or grey fascias (80 %)
  - Grunder/Koningshoef (33 %)
  - Hechtelstraat in Nieuw-Sloten (most of Nieuw-Sloten is too varied for one design)
- **Running total:** about **7,450 houses on ~55 designs in 22 neighbourhoods**, from about 3,000 at the start of the day.
- **Bug fixed:** rows facing each other across a street could break the left/right mirroring. That's fixed.
- **Still can't model:** open stairwells, weatherboarding, per-house brick colours inside one row, and eaves brackets.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (#78)**

- **White trim is white.** Window frames, sills, door surrounds and fascias on the terraced designs used to draw cream or beige. The specs already said white, but the trim was being sent to the sandstone and cream material slots. It now draws a neutral white, capped so nothing glares in the sun. 224 house models were recoloured; their geometry is unchanged.
- **Fewer draw calls:** each house model is now drawn once instead of once per material.
  - The Nieuwendam view went from 122 to 38 draws.
  - Reigersbos 4 went from 80 to 18, and De Eendracht from 97 to 18.
  - City-wide, these houses would cost about 500 draws instead of 2,400.
- **Next:** more neighbourhoods, and chunkier window joinery where the photos show it.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (round 5)**

- **Speckled brick:** a wall can now mix several brick tones. It costs no extra geometry, just one small texture per mix. The K-buurt rows now show their grey-brown mottle instead of flat brown.
- **1,606 more houses:**
  - Tuindorp Nieuwendam-Oost: 660, about half the area, garden-village rows with orange pantiles
  - Reigersbos 3: 212
  - Reigersbos 4: 480
  - De Eendracht in Geuzenveld: 254
- **Running total:** about **6,500 houses on ~45 designs in 18 neighbourhoods**.
- **Weak spots:**
  - White window frames and trim draw beige across many designs, where the photos show crisp white.
  - Nieuwendam costs about 120 draw calls in one area because of end/middle/mirror variants.

  Both are going to lane #78.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (round 4)**

- **Roof tiles are now the colour of the photos.** Terraced designs can take their tile colour from the street photo, cross-checked against the aerial photo. Amstelstation's roofs went from orange to brown-red, and the Circus/Kermisbuurt concrete tiles are now olive instead of slate. Only colours changed; no shapes.
- **Four more neighbourhoods, 547 houses:** Dichtersbuurt (81 %), Gooise Kant (95 %), K-buurt-Zuidwest (37 %) and Buiksloterbreek (49 %).
- **Total so far:** repetitive designs now cover about 4,900 houses in 14 neighbourhoods.
- **Weak spots:**
  - K-buurt's speckled grey-brown brick draws flat dark brown; the kit can't do mottled brick yet.
  - The K-buurt and Buiksloterbreek numbers are lower because those neighbourhoods mix in other house types.
- **Housekeeping:** the visual brightness test that #73 broke is fixed (#76) and now runs on every integration.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (#73)**

- **The big modelled buildings are a little brighter.** Two changes:
  - Their brick now gets the same sunlight boost as ordinary street walls.
  - 82 of them take their sloped-roof colour from the aerial photo.

  The effect is modest: walls brighten by 2–4 luma, and the Kattenburg roofs go from 85 to 95.
- **What's still dark, and why:**
  - **Herengracht landmarks:** they use their own hand-picked builder colours.
  - **Bilderdijkstraat block fronts:** they're drawn at their photo's exposure.
  - **The Palace and Magna Plaza roofs:** fixing them means rebuilding every landmark.
- **A visual test was already failing.** The building-look test fails 2 cases on main, from before #73. Lane #76 is tracking down which commit broke it and fixing the cause.
- **Round 4 (#75) is still running:** roof-tile colours plus four more neighbourhoods.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (round 3)**

- **Four more neighbourhoods (#74) are live.** **855 houses** now use 10 designs:
  - Tuindorp Amstelstation (87 % of houses): chimneyed brick rows with coloured balconies and doors
  - Circus/Kermisbuurt (83 %): single-slope roofs
  - Twiske-Oost (68 %): striped brick
  - Vogeltjeswei (81 %): round bay windows
- **Running total for repetitive neighbourhoods:** about 4,350 houses on 22 designs, across 10 neighbourhoods.
- **Wrong yet:** roof tile colours. Amstelstation reads too orange and Circus draws slate where the real tiles are olive. Round 4 (#75) adds a photo-measured tile colour and fixes these, then does K-buurt-Zuidwest, Gooise Kant, Buiksloterbreek and Dichtersbuurt.
- **Still running:** #73, brighter walls and sloped roofs on the big modelled buildings.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (night)**

- **Noord terraces (#72) are live.** Four designs measured from street photos now cover **1,949 houses**: 1,282 in Tuindorp Oostzaan-Oost (64 %) and 667 in Blauwe Zand (80 %). You'll see orange-tiled cottages with dormers and paired doors, and Blauwe Zand's green boarded gables.
- **The kit learned** dormers (including half dormers that pair across a party wall), paired gables, and size classes, so a design can cover two plot depths without stretching.
- **Running total for repetitive-neighbourhood designs today:** about 3,500 houses on 12 designs.
- **Cost:** draw calls in those two areas went up by 90–130, but frames are still at the 60 fps cap.
- **Next:** #73, brighter walls and pitched roofs on the big modelled buildings.

**Dev log, 25 Oct (late)**

- **Dark big buildings (#71): it isn't the lighting.** Every pipeline lights a north wall the same way (about 0.78 of a south wall). The darkness comes from colour:
  - **Flat roofs:** the big modelled buildings used a dark tar colour. 149 of them now take the roof colour from the aerial photo, and the rest get light gravel. That's 103 models re-exported with only the material changed. Haarlemmerweg roofs went from 102 to 108 brightness.
  - **Still dark:** slate pitched roofs, which have no measured colour yet, and walls measured from photos, which come out 20–30 brightness darker than the generated rows next door. Lane #73 is on this next.
- **Rate limit:** both lanes paused for a few hours on the plan's session limit and resumed cleanly.
- **Noord terraces (#72)** is still running (Tuindorp Oostzaan-Oost, Blauwe Zand).

**Dev log, 25 Oct (evening)**

- **Haarlemmerweg / Westerpark (#65) is live.** 13 big blocks across the water from the park are real models now. Their north fronts still read a bit dark. The cause is the lighting of large buildings in general (north faces shade to ~58 %, flat roofs render as dark bitumen), not these models. Lane #71 is fixing that across the city.
- **Zuidoost terraces (#70) are live.** This is the 'newer areas repeat' idea. Eight designs measured from street photos now cover **1,540 houses** in Gein 3, Holendrecht-Oost, Gein 4 and Kelbergen (12 %, 52 %, 65 % and 78 % of each neighbourhood). Each row keeps one roof line, and draw calls didn't move. That is about 190 houses per design, against one building per session on the landmark path. This is where kit work really scales.
- **Kit additions:** door canopies, facade battens, coloured bands, asymmetric roofs with low backs, roof heights read from 3D roof planes.
- **Still missing:** dormers (about 1 house in 4), per-house door colours, front sheds, and a couple of Gein 3 / Holendrecht groups.

## 2026-10-25 (evening): free ride, windmills, neighbourhood pages

**Landed (main 42712b58b)**
- **Free ride (#67).** Pick "Free ride" on the start screen and ride anywhere: no route, no questions. Nearby landmarks and named bridges get markers, and tapping a marker, a building, a street or a canal opens its card. Exit is top right.
  - Next ideas: arrows at the screen edge for places that are off screen, markers on streets, a GPS "here" start.
- **Windmills (#66).** Every windmill inside the A10 ring is now in the game. De Bloem, De Otter and D'Admiraal join De Gooyer, each with a card.
- **Neighbourhood pages (#69).** 78 pages at /buurt/: a postcard, in-game views, the modelled buildings, trivia and name stories.

**Running**
- **#65** Haarlemmerweg tall buildings.
- **#70** Repetitive newer neighbourhoods as instanced designs (Gein 3, Holendrecht-Oost, Gein 4, Kelbergen). This follows the user's idea: about 81,600 post-1960 buildings, and one 5×6 m house type repeats almost 1,000 times in Gein 3 alone.

## 2026-10-25 (later): Vondelpark and road surfaces merged

**Landed (main 748f4d64e)**
- **Vondelpark south edge (#62):** six big houses are now real models: Van Eeghenstraat 97, 110 and 180, Koningslaan 28, Park Plaza (Koninginneweg 34) and Emmalaan 4.
  - I sent two back after reviewing the sheets: Van Eeghenstraat 180's slate mansard rendered as pale stone, and Park Plaza was missing its white bay windows. Both are fixed.
  - Five went in with some walls marked "photo can't judge" (winter shade, an autumn tree, only oblique photos).
  - Held: Koninginneweg 1, the biggest building on the park. Its fallback shell (the PDOK building geometry) has a broken wall, and the 3DBAG height data keeps timing out.
- **Road surfaces (#63):** asphalt and the cycle paths have a fine grain when seen close up, and the last guessed road markings are off. The visible change is small, because pavers and survey-only markings were already in.
- **Refused-installs batch 2 (#59):** 20 more installed buildings were refitted against their photos.
- The reviewed-building count is 501.

**Running**
- #65 Haarlemmerweg tall buildings (south side of the Westerpark)
- #66 windmills inside the A10
- #67 free ride mode
- #69 neighbourhood pages

**Question to the user, open:** should the next building lane be an automatic factory batch (20 buildings drafted from measurements, then one review sheet) to get a real throughput number?

## 2026-10-25: status

**Landed today (on main)**
- Centraal ground: the stairwell craters are levelled, plus about 3,600 small pits city-wide (#53).
- Rail viaduct west of Centraal: the Droogbak passage now runs at street level under a deck (#57).
- Road look, city-wide (#52): rails drawn as dark grooves, kerb shadow lines, softer cycle red, islands as raised paving.
- White screen flashes fixed (#64): the governor's resize used to blank one frame.
- Likeness gate:
  - it now reads mixed-width window rows and the real street level (#58);
  - shade, glare, pale panels and ribbons are handled better (#61);
  - known-wrong models still fail.
- Installed buildings that the gate refused: 31 refitted against their photos so far (#59, batches 1 and 2), plus Oostpoort Montessori and pand 165427 newly installed.

**Kit work in general**
Every building lane now adds the components its photos need. Added today:
- `windowBox` (projecting glazed boxes)
- `arcadePiers`
- `openBays` on the ground storey
- louvre slats
- `balconies.run` (joined galleries)
- `storeyFactors` (per-storey heights)
- `gallery` (verandas and loggias)
- `mansard` faces
- thin speklagen
- lists of oriels with railings

The honest picture:
- The gate refuses about 80 of 94 installed large houses. After two refit batches most of them are visibly closer to their photos, but many walls still pass only as "inferred". That is sometimes a real gate misread (trees, overcast light, mullions counted as columns) and sometimes a kit gap.
- Recurring gaps:
  - a different system per storey;
  - several window types on one front;
  - a lattice crown;
  - a deep arcade canopy;
  - curved glass bays;
  - Louis XV gables and dormers;
  - shutters;
  - open iron railings.
- Spot checks that are still below the bar: Haarlemmerweg 325 (its silver screen reads as dark stripes) and Tilanusstraat 23 (missing rooftop pavilions).

**Lanes running**
- #62 Vondelpark south edge: 6 built, Koninginneweg 1 held (broken shell, 3DBAG timing out); integrating now.
- #63 City-wide road surfaces: asphalt and cycle grain, guessed paint off; integrating now. Small visible change, because most of it already existed.
- #65 Tall buildings on Haarlemmerweg, south side of the Westerpark.
- #66 Every windmill inside the A10 (only De Gooyer is modelled today).
- #67 Free ride / free play mode.

**Parked**
- Per-junction road work judged against photos (too expensive for what it shows).
